		cost = 0
		fire_only_once = no
		visible = {
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } }
			OR = {
				AND = { has_country_flag = ht_spirit_remove event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { has_idea = idea_RAJ_government_budget_shortfall } } }
				AND = { has_country_flag = ht_spirit_add event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_RAJ_government_budget_shortfall } OR = { has_focus_tree = indian_focus_goe } } } }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = { exists = yes } } }
			event_target:ht_focus_state = { owner = {
				if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = ht_spirit_remove } } remove_ideas = idea_RAJ_government_budget_shortfall }
				else = { add_ideas = idea_RAJ_government_budget_shortfall }
			} }
			}
		}
	}
